text: The helper returns empty for no URI or about:blank. File input uses its file URI despite MIME or service-icon metadata. Non-file input prefers explicit MIME, then a service icon, then a guessed final URI segment with dummy.html fallback. Tests directly check those exact strings, including retained query text; they do not render icons or validate remote data. This helper landing is separate from later UI consumers.
title: Calendar attachment icon selection gives file and MIME metadata priority
